$comment: The only place to change TwoUX's look. primary: a palette family (indigo, blue, teal, green...) or any #RRGGBB brand colour. radius: px for inside a control (xs), controls and cards (sm), floating layers (md); optional button: px or "pill". motion: tempo from 0.75 (quicker) to 1.25 (calmer) scales every duration; character "standard" or "crisp" (no overshoot on pops). Run pnpm theme after editing; it refuses colours that fail WCAG contrast and warns when the brand is close to a status colour.
